intro.fallback: Right before Shikamaru and Kiba were about to die, they were aided by Temari and Kankurō respectively, who had been ordered to help the Konoha ninja.
Kankurō's puppets were unaffected by Sakon and Ukon's ability to fuse with cells.

When Sakon arrived, he attempted to do the same thing he had almost done with Kiba, but Kankurō turned out to be his new puppet, Kuroari, to injure Sakon, forcing them to fuse back and Ukon to take over.

outro.fallback: Shikamaru used this time to tell Temari about Tayuya's strategies.
